name: Shishou
source:
Simply know as Shishou, he is a mentor figure to protagonist and his friends. He is a mystery with not much known about him. He disappeared one day and hasn't been heard from in years. 


[spoiler] He is the father of Shiina Yukari  [/spoiler]
